project_type: Monorepo: React SPA (Vite) frontend + FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Workers edge
build_system: pnpm workspaces (pnpm@10.26.1), Vite for frontend, wrangler for edge, pip for backend
build_command: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build (frontend); pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit (edge lint)
test_command: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test (frontend); pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test (edge); pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q (backend)
verification_instructions: 1. Run edge TypeScript lint: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit. 2. Run edge tests: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test. 3. Run backend tests: pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q. 4. Run frontend tests: pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit test.
setup_instructions: 1. corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate. 2. pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile. 3. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt (with hash stripping for local dev).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Node 22+. Python 3.11+. No Docker daemon guaranteed. Frontend build requires VITE_BACKEND_URL env var for prerender to reach backend.
contribution_requirements: Must not break existing prerender pipeline. Build must complete within Cloudflare Pages 20-min limit. Edge worker types in apps/edge/src/env.d.ts must stay in sync with wrangler.toml bindings.
key_patterns: Prerender scripts in apps/frontend/scripts/ use fetchJson with retry+backoff from _prerender-data.mjs. Edge worker uses typed Env interface. Backend uses FastAPI router pattern (app.include_router). JSON-LD is centralized in apps/frontend/src/lib/jsonld.js with buildSchemaForPageType/dedupeGraphTypes. PageMeta component manages head tags via useEffect (no react-helmet). Prerender injects HTML directly via rewriteHead() and injectShell().
directory_structure: Monorepo root with pnpm workspaces. apps/frontend/ = React SPA with Vite (scripts/ has prerender pipeline, src/ has pages/components/lib). apps/edge/ = Cloudflare Worker (src/index.ts entry, src/middleware/, src/routes/). apps/backend/ = FastAPI (app/api/v1/ routers, app/services/, app/core/, tests/). .github/workflows/ = CI/CD.
